title: Supramolecular complexation of nanoclusters with a non-fluorinated polymer for proton exchange membranes at intermediate temperatures
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28619-28626
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02438F, Paper
Open Access

Junjie Zhou, Shanshan Guo, Zihao Zhang, Chuanjin Zhao, Xinpei Li
A glycerol-plasticized composite membrane creates continuous proton channels via 3D conductive networks, disrupting polymer chain order to lower resistance. It enables robust proton conduction under intermediate-temperature, low-humidity conditions.
